I am sure you will be fine, but I guess everybody should be on pins and
needles.  You don't think they would eliminate any of the trading function,
do you?  How is the mood today?  I know my colleagues at EOL are pissed,
upset, nervous and sad.

Let me know if you hear anything good.

Dawn
----- Original Message -----
From: <Darron.C.Giron@enron.com>
To: <dkenne@houston.rr.com>
Sent: Monday, November 12, 2001 7:40 AM
Subject: RE: Pictures of Grace


> Yes, by Skilling mostly.  I can't believe that a handful of people brought
> the company all the way down to the point of bankruptcy.  Basically, they
> took all the money that the core businesses made and pissed it all away in
> poor investments (broadband, India, Azurix, etc...)  I just hope I have a
> job thru the holidays.  I feel vulnerable because I'm the new one in this
> group.  I would feel more secure if I was still in risk.  Oh well, I guess
> it's wait and see.
>
> DG
